title: Troll Table Gutter Crumble Pie
tagline: A pudding for trolls, built entirely from the bottom of the garden.
rhyme:
Stir the pot, stir the pot, in goes a boot,
Add a gutter-gunk dollop and a tatty tree root.
Tip in soggy leaves, brown and curled,
And the smelliest socks in the whole wide world.
Pencil shavings next, and a bobble hat's bobble,
Stir till it glops and begins to wobble.
Top it with twigs and a splat of pond slime,
Then serve it to trolls at pudding time!

ingredients.item: old left boot, tongue still flapping
bobble from a lost woolly hat

steps:
Line a pie dish with the boot, flat and wide,
With its tongue lolling out on the starboard side.

Pat in the leaves with a troll-sized shove,
The squelch will be heard in the room above.

Bury the socks and the pencil bits too,
Then leave them to stew for a year or two.

Plop on the slime and the twigs on top,
Then stand well back till the wobbling stops.
image_prompt: A deep pie dish holding a lumpy brown pie made from a cracked old leather boot, heaped soggy leaves, and tangled roots. Green slime oozes over the top, with twigs sticking out and a tatty woolly bobble perched in the middle. A striped odd sock hangs over the rim.
alt_text: A lumpy pie of old boot, soggy leaves and twigs, topped with green slime and a woolly bobble, with a sock draped over the dish.
caption_hook: Today's pudding comes with a boot tongue and a lot of regret. The trolls are already fighting over the last twig.
